featured_reviews.name: Kusal Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Tucked away in an aesthetic corner of South Bombay, this bookstore is a true haven for book lovers. With its charming atmosphere and thoughtfully curated shelves, it offers an impressive range of genres that caters to every kind of reader. Whether you’re hunting for a classic, exploring contemporary fiction, or diving into niche subjects, this place makes browsing feel like an experience rather than just a visit. A must-stop spot for any book nerd wandering through the city.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Bishnoi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ashish Book Centre, tucked away near the bustling CSMT Railway Station in Fort, is nothing short of a paradise for true book lovers. In a city that’s always racing against time, this bookstore feels like a quiet, timeless refuge where stories patiently wait to be discovered.

What makes Ashish Book Centre truly special is its incredible collection. From rare second-hand classics and academic textbooks to novels, competitive exam guides, and out-of-print treasures—you never know what gem you’ll stumble upon. Browsing through the shelves feels like going on a literary treasure hunt, and every visit brings a new surprise.

The owners and staff are extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They don’t just sell books; they understand them. Whether you walk in with a specific title in mind or just a vague idea of what you want to read, they guide you with genuine enthusiasm and honesty. Their passion for books is infectious.

Another big win is the affordability. Ashish Book Centre proves that great reading doesn’t have to be expensive. Students, avid readers, and collectors alike will appreciate the fair pricing and excellent condition of the books.

Located in the heart of Fort, just a stone’s throw from CSMT, it’s incredibly convenient and perfectly placed for a spontaneous visit after work or college. Despite the chaos outside, the store offers a calm, almost nostalgic vibe that reminds you why physical bookstores still matter.

If you love books, value knowledge, or simply enjoy the charm of old-school bookstores, Ashish Book Centre is an absolute must-visit. It’s not just a shop—it’s an experience, a legacy, and a reminder that the love for reading is very much alive in Mumbai. 📚

featured_reviews.name: Radhikaa Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the Geeta Press outlet at Princess Street, Marine Lines for the first time after my marriage, and the experience was truly memorable.🤌✨️ Amidst the busy lanes of South Mumbai, stepping inside felt like entering a small temple of knowledge. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming, a refreshing contrast to the bustle outside.✨️😇

The shelves are lined with beautifully printed Hindu scriptures and books– Bhagavad Gita, Ramcharitmanas, and many other timeless spiritual texts–all offered at very reasonable prices. The staff here are courteous, patient, and genuinely helpful, guiding visitors to the right editions or translations with humility. Their respectful approach adds to the sacred aura of the place.

What stands out most is the purity of purpose–Geeta Press has always been dedicated to spreading spiritual wisdom rather than commercial gain, and this branch reflects that ethos perfectly. It feels less like shopping and more like receiving blessings in the form of literature.

⚠️One practical note: parking in this area can be challenging due to narrow, crowded lanes. It’s often easier to reach by taxi or walking from nearby stations. But once inside, the serenity of the store makes you forget the outside chaos.

For anyone seeking authentic Hindu scriptures and spiritual books, along with a touch of old Mumbai charm, Geeta Press Gorakhpur at Princess Street is a treasure worth cherishing.

featured_reviews.name: Anuja Kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gita Press is a treasure trove of spiritual wisdom and one of the most respected publishers of Hindu religious texts.

They offer a vast collection of Bhagavad Gita, Ramayana, Mahabharata, Puranas, Upanishads, and other sacred scriptures in multiple Indian languages at highly affordable prices.

The quality of printing and binding is excellent, making these books accessible to everyone. They also publish moral and spiritual books for children and adults, along with monthly magazines like Kalyan and Kalyana-Kalpataru to spread the message of dharma.

A must-visit place for anyone seeking authentic Hindu scriptures and spiritual enlightenment.

Parking- Situated on main road hence no Parking Available, side Streets Parking may be explored at your luck.

Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: I had ordered 'The Aviator's Handbook, 5th Edition' by Cdr. Thomas Tom from Sterling Book House via SpeedPost and had received my shipment on-time. Secondly, I got my Invoice & shipment tracking information all in my email. At the same time, they provided real time support to me over WhatsApp regarding shipment status. And thirdly, when I received my parcel safely then it was very well packed with brown cardboard and plastic sheet. The book was also in very good condition. My whole experience with Sterling Book House was really excellent and fulfilling. Based on my experience with Sterling Book House, I will definitely order more and more aviation books from them in the future.

owner_posts.post_text:
Cyber Law & Cyber Crimes Simplified | Practical Guide with AI-Enabled Cyber Crimes Coverage | 8th Edition 2026

Cyber Law & Cyber Crimes Simplified is a practical and easy-to-understand guide authored by one of India's most recognized cyber law experts. The book bridges the gap between legal theory and real-world cybercrime challenges by covering cyber offences, digital evidence, data privacy, online investigations, and emerging AI-enabled cyber crimes. It is particularly useful for advocates, law students, police officers, compliance professionals, corporate legal teams, cybersecurity practitioners, and anyone seeking a clear understanding of India's cyber law framework.

Business Champ | A Complete Roadmap to Transform Your Business

Business Champ is a practical business transformation guide written by Chartered Accountant, entrepreneur, and business mentor Malay Damania. Drawing from more than three decades of advising business owners, the book combines entrepreneurial mindset, leadership, team building, communication, financial discipline, and growth strategies into a structured roadmap. Unlike theoretical management books, it focuses on real-world challenges faced by MSMEs, startups, family businesses, and growing enterprises. An excellent resource for entrepreneurs seeking sustainable growth and better business decision-making.

The Bench, the Bar and the Bizarre

If you think the law is always solemn and predictable, this book politely disagrees—and then proves it with style. The Bench, the Bar and the Bizarre takes you into the lesser-seen corners of the legal world, where logic sometimes takes a coffee break and reality feels stranger than fiction.

Through a series of real-life courtroom episodes, Tushar Mehta presents a fascinating blend of wit, absurdity, and insight. From unconventional judicial behavior to cases that stretch imagination, the book captures the unpredictable human side of law.

The Lawful and the Awful
Law is often seen as stern, structured, and serious—but this book flips the courtroom script. The Lawful and the Awful is a refreshing dive into the quirky, human, and sometimes bizarre side of the legal world.

Drawing from real courtroom episodes across jurisdictions, Tushar Mehta blends wit, sarcasm, and sharp observation to narrate stories where law meets personality—and sometimes loses the plot. From eccentric judges to unexpected courtroom moments, this book captures the lighter yet thought-provoking side of justice.

Stamp Duty Ready Reckoner and Market Value of Properties in Mumbai 2026-27

When it comes to property transactions in Mumbai, guesswork is expensive. This Ready Reckoner is your official-style compass—clear, updated, and built for real-world execution.

Before independence was won on the streets, it was fought inside courtrooms. Freedom on Trial brings to life twelve landmark cases that shaped India’s struggle against colonial rule—where law became both a weapon and a battlefield.

Written with depth and narrative power, this book captures how trials of freedom fighters were not mere legal proceedings, but turning points in India’s constitutional and political journey.

With a foreword by Justice D.Y. Chandrachud and endorsements from leading legal minds, this is more than history—it is a reminder of how law can define the destiny of a nation.

For lawyers, it offers perspective. For readers, it offers pride.

About the Book:
Some books don’t just explain law—they shape how we think about justice itself. A Theory of Justice by John Rawls is one of the most influential works in political and legal philosophy, redefining concepts of fairness, equality, and rights.

Through ideas like the “veil of ignorance” and justice as fairness, Rawls builds a framework that continues to influence constitutional thought, public policy, and legal reasoning worldwide.

For lawyers and law students, this is not just philosophy—it is the foundation behind many principles that courts interpret and apply.

Multiple Choice Questions for Judicial Service Examination

Multiple Choice Questions for Judicial Service Examination by Rajan Gunjikar is a focused and exam-oriented compilation designed specifically for Judicial Service aspirants. Covering key Minor Acts frequently tested in Civil Judge (Junior Division), District Judge, and Family Court examinations, this book equips candidates with objective-type questions that sharpen precision, speed, and statutory clarity. Authored by a former District Judge, the book reflects practical judicial insight aligned with competitive examination patterns.
Multiple Choice Questions for Judicial Service Examination – Major Acts

How to Handle GST Appeals – Practical Guide with Real-Life Case Studies

How to Handle GST Appeals is a practical, litigation-focused guide designed for professionals dealing with appellate proceedings under GST law. Authored by Adv. Md Samar, this 2026 edition combines statutory framework with real-life case studies to provide step-by-step clarity on drafting appeals, preparing grounds, handling hearings, and managing procedural compliance. For tax practitioners, advocates, and consultants, this book bridges the gap between theory and courtroom strategy in GST disputes.

featured_reviews.name: CA TAX SAVER
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ Review of M & J Services - A Truly Professional & Customer-Centric Experience

I have been a customer of M & J Services for the last 4-5 years, and my recent experience while purchasing the latest Income Tax Act 2025 books once again confirmed why I continue buying from them.

Here’s what stood out for me:

📱 **1. Extremely Prompt WhatsApp Support**

The conversation started on WhatsApp, and the response was almost instant. The communication throughout was professional, polite, and transparent.

📚 **2. Actual Photos - Not Catalogue Images**

When I asked for recommendations between Commercial’s and Taxmann’s editions, they shared real photographs of the books being held in hand.

This genuinely helped me understand the size and appearance of the books before purchasing.

📖 **3. Thoughtful Comparison of Pocket vs Regular Edition**

I asked about pocket editions as well. They informed me that the Taxmann pocket edition was currently not available in stock, whereas the Commercial pocket edition was available.

What impressed me was that they went a step further - they placed both the regular edition and the pocket edition side-by-side on a table and shared comparison photos showing the actual size and thickness difference.

Very helpful for decision-making.

💡 **4. Honest Recommendation Instead of Sales Push**

Since I am a practicing tax consultant, I asked which publication they would personally recommend.

They suggested Commercial’s edition as being more suitable for working professionals. What I appreciated was that the recommended option was actually cheaper than the alternative after discount.

That reflected genuine guidance rather than an attempt to sell the costlier product.

💰 **5. Transparent Pricing & Billing**

The prices and discounts were clearly mentioned directly below the book photos in the WhatsApp chat itself.

Before payment, they also shared the complete bill properly reflecting all discounts.

🚚 **6. Clear Delivery Options**

They clearly explained both delivery choices:

• Normal delivery (takes a couple of days)
• Same-day delivery through WeFast

After I opted for WeFast, they coordinated smoothly using the Google location I shared and ensured quick dispatch.

✅ **Final Verdict**

Professional communication, transparent pricing, practical recommendations, and genuinely customer-oriented service.

Highly recommended for anyone purchasing law, tax, and professional books.
